desc: Enumerate all valid layer partitions (a_1,...,a_k) for given N with alternating sums N/2 and N/2-1.
For each fixed layer partition, compute the number of connected subgraphs of the complete bipartite chain with exactly M edges using a DP over the chain of bipartite layers.
Multiply by the number of ways to assign specific vertices to the layers (multinomial coefficient) and sum over all partitions to get f(M) for each M.
Verify with sample inputs (N=4,6,10) and optimize for N up to 30.
Write final Python code with modulo P arithmetic and precompute factorials for combinations.
